cards.example_en: With a smile, the shopkeeper gave the child a free apple.
cards.example_zh: 店主微笑着给了孩子一个免费的苹果。

cards.example_en: Your signature is needed on this form before the school trip.
cards.example_zh: 学校旅行之前，这份表格上需要你的签名。

cards.example_en: Sip the hot tea slowly so you do not burn your tongue.
cards.example_zh: 热茶要慢慢小口喝，以免烫到舌头。

cards.example_en: Every visitor stared at the dinosaur skeleton in the museum.
cards.example_zh: 每位游客都盯着博物馆里的恐龙骨骼看。

cards.example_en: Please do not slam the door when the baby is sleeping.
cards.example_zh: 宝宝睡觉时，请不要砰地把门关上。

cards.example_en: In the legend the knight must slay the dragon to save the town.
cards.example_zh: 传说中，骑士必须杀死恶龙才能拯救小镇。

cards.example_en: Across the bright stage, the slender dancer moved very lightly.
cards.example_zh: 苗条的舞者非常轻盈地走过明亮的舞台。

cards.example_en: In that old story, the sly fox stole food from a farm.
cards.example_zh: 在那个古老的故事里，狡猾的狐狸从农场偷走了食物。

cards.example_en: If you kick too hard, the ball may smash the kitchen window.
cards.example_zh: 如果你踢得太用力，球可能会打碎厨房的窗户。

cards.example_en: During the team meeting, his snappy reply made everyone laugh.
cards.example_zh: 队会期间，他干脆的回答把大家都逗笑了。

cards.example_en: Dogs sniff the ground when they look for a lost ball.
cards.example_zh: 狗寻找丢失的球时会嗅地面。

cards.example_en: My father may snore loudly after a long day at work.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸工作了一整天后，可能会大声打鼾。

cards.example_en: When it saw the open gate, the horse began to snort.
cards.example_zh: 那匹马看见大门敞开，就开始喷鼻息。

cards.example_en: After the first snowfall, we built a snowman in the garden.
cards.example_zh: 第一场雪之后，我们在花园里堆了一个雪人。

cards.example_en: Wash your hands with soap before you sit down to eat.
cards.example_zh: 坐下吃饭之前，要用肥皂把手洗干净。

cards.example_en: Anna is sociable and talks with new students at lunch.
cards.example_zh: 安娜很好交际，午饭时会和新同学聊天。

cards.example_en: Let's meet sometime next week for a walk in the park.
cards.example_zh: 我们下周找个时间去公园散步吧。

cards.example_en: On a quiet red planet, the spaceship in the film finally landed.
cards.example_zh: 电影里的宇宙飞船最终降落在一颗寂静的红色星球上。

cards.example_en: Dad used a spade to plant flowers along the garden wall.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸用铲子沿着花园的墙种下了花。

cards.example_en: When the team scored, every spectator stood up and cheered.
cards.example_zh: 球队进球时，每一位观众都站起来欢呼。

cards.example_en: This spice makes the chicken taste richer and warmer.
cards.example_zh: 这种香料让鸡肉吃起来更浓郁、更温热。

cards.example_en: For my little brother, the spicy noodles were much too hot.
cards.example_zh: 这辣面条对我弟弟来说实在太辣了。

cards.example_en: A large spider sat in the web above the shed door.
cards.example_zh: 一只大蜘蛛停在棚屋门上方的网上。

cards.example_en: Children splash water at each other in the swimming pool.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们在游泳池里互相溅水。

cards.example_en: Sprinkle a little salt on the eggs before you serve them.
cards.example_zh: 上菜之前，在鸡蛋上撒一点盐。

cards.example_en: Grilled squid is my favourite dish at the night market.
cards.example_zh: 烤鱿鱼是我在夜市最喜欢的菜。

cards.example_en: We bought oranges from a fruit stall near the station.
cards.example_zh: 我们在车站附近的水果摊买了橙子。

cards.example_en: Keep a steady pace so you can finish the long race.
cards.example_zh: 保持稳定的步伐，这样你就能完成这场长跑。

cards.example_en: Along the wide river, the old steamboat carried many passengers.
cards.example_zh: 那艘旧汽船载着许多乘客，沿着宽阔的河行驶。

cards.example_en: My little sister asked me to read her favourite storybook before bedtime.
cards.example_zh: 我妹妹让我在睡前给她读她最喜欢的故事书。

cards.example_en: After the rain stopped, the view from the hotel window was stunning.
cards.example_zh: 雨停之后，酒店窗外的景色美极了。

cards.example_en: She wore a stylish coat to the city concert last Friday.
cards.example_zh: 上周五她穿着一件时髦的外套去听了城里的音乐会。

cards.example_en: We followed the subtitle at the bottom to understand the French film.
cards.example_zh: 我们靠底部的字幕看懂了这部法国电影。

cards.example_en: Can you subtract fifteen from forty without using a calculator?
cards.example_zh: 你能不用计算器从四十里面减去十五吗？

cards.example_en: After the broken oven caused a fire, the shop owner decided to sue the company.
cards.example_zh: 坏烤箱引起火灾后，店主决定起诉那家公司。

cards.example_en: My cousin dressed as superman for the school play and made everyone laugh.
cards.example_zh: 我表弟在学校话剧里扮成超人，把大家都逗笑了。

cards.example_en: Fish and rice made a hot supper after swimming.
cards.example_zh: 游完泳以后，晚饭是热乎的鱼和米饭。

cards.example_en: Under the roof of our old house, a swallow built its nest.
cards.example_zh: 在我们老房子的屋顶下，一只燕子筑了巢。

cards.example_en: We saw a white swan swimming on the lake during our trip.
cards.example_zh: 旅行时我们看见一只白天鹅在湖面上游。

cards.example_en: Mum poured maple syrup over the hot pancakes at breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 早餐时妈妈把枫糖浆浇在热煎饼上。

cards.example_en: Look at the price tag on this jacket; it says eighty yuan.
cards.example_zh: 看看这件夹克上的价格标签，上面写着八十元。

cards.example_en: Outside the hotel, the taxi-driver helped us carry our heavy bags.
cards.example_zh: 在酒店外面，出租车司机帮我们拿了沉重的行李。

cards.example_en: Older students should not tease younger ones in the playground.
cards.example_zh: 大同学不应该在操场上取笑年幼的同学。

cards.example_en: Add one teaspoon of sugar if the coffee tastes too bitter.
cards.example_zh: 如果咖啡太苦，就加一茶匙糖。

cards.example_en: Every teen in our class wants to visit the science museum.
cards.example_zh: 我们班每个青少年都想去参观科学博物馆。

cards.example_en: Dad lost his temper when the dog chewed his new shoes.
cards.example_zh: 狗咬坏了爸爸的新鞋，他发了脾气。

cards.example_en: Students felt tense before the final maths test on Monday.
cards.example_zh: 周一期末数学考试前，学生们感到紧张。

cards.example_en: Everyone agreed the seafood dinner at the harbour was terrific.
cards.example_zh: 大家都觉得港口的海鲜晚餐好极了。

cards.example_en: Someone saw a thief steal a bicycle outside the school gate.
cards.example_zh: 有人看见一个小偷在校门外偷走了自行车。

cards.example_en: To mend this torn shirt, I need a needle and some thread.
cards.example_zh: 要补这件破衬衫，我需要一根针和一些线。
